scope: Count adjudication and final hash verification of independent all-body/source audit, supplemented by direct read of all case bodies and fixture. No case, SQL or runtime executed.
novelty_adjudication: Accept 18 individually motivated public facet/root mechanisms. Z214 remains retired with zero credit for its location-only duplication of Z213. Z211 credit rests on successful Promise-valued startup configuration resolved before constructor capture, not repeated laziness/caching controls. Z210 observes the independent native constructor-time typed-graph decode boundary. Z213 root rollback and Z215 handled child rollback test different independent-database outcomes.
runtime_qualification: All UNRUN. No runtime acceptance until actual source/build/deployment/process identity, fresh private store, enforced 12-second HTTP/20-second owned-process/420-second suite and RSS/output bounds, plus complete owned teardown. Logical cleanup uses same-name empty probes behind deletion barriers; residual empty probe facets require final external teardown.

os_relevance.basis: Preserved component acceptance/provenance ties facets/root/class/props/storage to OS mechanisms. Actual OS checkout and end-to-end execution remain unavailable and unqualified.

case_verdicts.reason: Omitted startup ID preserves named DurableObjectId kind, value and name through an immediate-parent inheritance chain. L024 only stringifies explicitly supplied equal display IDs.

Explicit named DurableObjectId and literal-string branches retain distinct public types/names; descendants inherit the immediate override or use their own explicit override. This is the supplied-ID serialization branch, distinct from Z201 default inheritance.

A single resident durable facet shares constructor token, heap progression and stored count through fetch to RPC to fetch. L012 selects different stateless exports; L017 asserts the opposite stateless receiver lifetime.

Documented plain (state, env) facet construction and js_rpc-enabled dispatch are exercised through the plain-class registration path. Shared receiver primitives do not supply extra credit beyond this independently supported class contract.
One positive full-depth branch reaches all four permitted levels, records distinct state at every level and preserves the root. No unsupported-depth error or extra count for individual levels.

Equal leaf names beneath two different live parent facet managers, with equal inherited visible IDs, select different databases. L024 only partitions top-level names; L037 concerns restored callback provenance.

A legal slash-containing name remains one component and cannot alias a two-component descendant path. The public name contract and independently hashed path segments support this ordinary-input boundary.

Three incompatible same-named SQL tables prove separate SQLite schema catalogs across root, child and grandchild. KV key separation in L022/L024 cannot establish this stronger database-catalog contract.

Mutable startup props persist on one durable receiver yet remain detached from the reusable class template used to start another facet. L036 only samples scalar binding snapshots; L015 resets stateless invocation props.

The only observation is a typed-graph summary captured inside the loaded facet constructor. This targets native embedded-startup decoding before construction, explicitly documented in bootstrap.rs, rather than repeating C001 RPC or D201/D202 storage serialization.

A successful Promise-valued startup-options callback awaits supervisor storage and supplies resolved props before the facet constructor captures them. Synchronous caching/laziness controls overlap L025/L027 but earn no separate credit.

A nested facet fetch forwards a finite POST and response metadata over two facet edges, while its effect is stored only in the selected descendant database. Generic request/body tests do not assert this facet routing and effect-placement boundary.
An ordinary explicit root transaction rollback removes the root write while an already awaited facet database write remains committed, exactly as the public facet documentation promises.

The inverse independent transaction outcome: child-local rollback returns a normal application decision, which the parent records while committing its own transaction. This tests the handled child outcome crossing back to a live parent transaction, not a location-only rerun of Z213.
storage.deleteAll clears only the current facet database and leaves its descendant and root intact. D211 resets one object; it cannot distinguish local storage reset from recursive facet deletion.

Selective nested leaf deletion followed immediately by a fresh same-name call observes the public delete/start barrier; parent and sibling data survive and the new leaf is writable. No stopped handle is invoked.

Deleting an internal facet removes every descendant database before same-path recreation while preserving root and adjacent sibling. Z217 only removes a leaf; production FacetStreams.delete prefix removal is separately evidenced.

Nested ctx.exports resolves the active module-local class and environment for both loopback and loaded facets. Relational module tokens distinguish same-isolate loopback from loaded module execution; L022/L023 only select direct loaded classes.
